response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with strong web and systems background, but the role demands deep, current C++ expertise in industrial automation with IEC 62443/SDL security practices. His professional C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago and a university thesis project, with his recent work concentrated in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. He lacks industrial cybersecurity, MQTT/IoT protocol, and message-broker-at-scale-in-C++ experience central to this position.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) exceeding the required range
Systems-level performance experience (low-latency, async I/O, multi-threaded services in DLang)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal and dated professional C++ experience; not listed among current skills
No exposure to industrial automation, IEC 62443, or Secure Development Lifecycle practices
No evidence of MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, or other industrial protocol experience

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and performance-systems experience
